notes: This is a rescript (توقيع) from an Imam that is not named in the text: rule 11 sends it to a ruling. «خرج على يد الشيخ أبي القاسم الحسين بن روح» names the conveyor of the rescript, not a transmitter; he is not added (rule 9). «أخبرنا جماعة» is unnamed (rule 8). The bracketed variants and «قال هارون» / «قال ابن داود» notes are the editor's, left out. The four routes carry the same rescript.
